integrity: The proof derives the support geometry directly from the definition. Positive support is an independent dominating set and hence a partial row-column matching saturating the smaller side. In the square case each zero sees two support vertices, giving all-2 permutation minima; with unequal sides an unoccupied column gives each row a zero with a unique support neighbor, forcing every support label to 3. The checker independently evaluates the definition on small boards.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for rectangular rook graphs with 2<=m<=n; the reverse ordering follows by symmetry.

The square scalar value is compatible with a published general equality criterion after one establishes the independent 2-domination structure; the optimizer classification and unequal-side phase are additional content.
Finite exhaustive verification covers only the smallest boards and is corroborative rather than an infinite proof.
A differently phrased or non-indexed exact treatment of the same family may exist.
title: Independent double Roman domination of rectangular rook graphs
